title.en: Fetch a page through a SOCKS5 proxy
title.hinglish: SOCKS5 proxy ke through page fetch karo

why.en: Shows the proxy doing the DNS lookup (--socks5-hostname sends the name, like address type 3). You need a SOCKS server of your own, e.g. start one with ssh -D 1080 user@yourserver.
why.hinglish: Dikhata hai ki DNS lookup proxy karta hai (--socks5-hostname name bhejta hai, jaise address type 3). Aapko apna SOCKS server chahiye, jaise ssh -D 1080 user@yourserver se start karo.

expect.en: HTTP response headers from example.com (HTTP/1.1 200 OK). If no SOCKS server listens on 1080 you get 'Failed to connect' instead. Output varies by machine.
expect.hinglish: example.com ke HTTP response headers (HTTP/1.1 200 OK). Agar 1080 pe koi SOCKS server nahi sun raha to 'Failed to connect' aayega. Output machine ke hisaab se alag ho sakta hai.

title.en: Watch the SOCKS5 handshake in verbose mode
title.hinglish: Verbose mode mein SOCKS5 handshake dekho

why.en: curl -v prints each handshake stage: greeting, method choice, login and connect.
why.hinglish: curl -v har handshake stage print karta hai: greeting, method choice, login aur connect.

expect.en: Lines such as 'SOCKS5 communication to example.com:80' and 'SOCKS5 request granted'. A wrong password shows 'User was rejected by the SOCKS5 server'. Exact text varies by curl version.
expect.hinglish: 'SOCKS5 communication to example.com:80' aur 'SOCKS5 request granted' jaisi lines. Galat password pe 'User was rejected by the SOCKS5 server' dikhta hai. Exact text curl version pe depend karta hai.

title.en: Find the SOCKS packets in the capture

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark and filter for the SOCKS messages.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur SOCKS messages filter karo.

expect.en: The greeting, method reply, login and CONNECT packets are listed; the password is visible in clear text.
expect.hinglish: Greeting, method reply, login aur CONNECT packets list mein dikhenge; password clear text mein dikhta hai.
